title: Medtrum Nano Preferences: Hourly and Daily Maximum Insulin settings do not persisted on modfication
symptom: In AndroidAPS 3.3.1.0-dev with Medtrum Nano pump, the Hourly and Daily Maximum Insulin settings in Medtrum Preferences cannot be modified; the user can change the value but it is not persisted.
fix: The issue was resolved by a commit (7c000911068903ed7477c1fcb9d80dc88a893baf). After this change, preference changes are persisted.
